text: Despite being a splendid, relaxing summer day, the atmosphere inside the Mahjong Soul Shrine is as oppressive as if thunderclouds were looming, and everyone looks nervous... I'd just stepped into the room to bring Ichihime some snacks, but upon seeing the scene before me, I take a deep breath and have a hunch.
player
{character:player}It must be that girl who's been coming here a lot recently that created such a heavy atmosphere, like "the devil's in the house."
{character:Chiori Mikami}Yakuman!
Sure enough, I'd barely finished speaking when I spot the blonde girl playing a lively match, her conspicuous red hairband like a warning to strangers to approach at their own peril.
Glancing at the table, the number of scattered scoring sticks clearly indicates that Chiori Mikami has just totally crushed her opponents.
Chiori Mikami

{character:Chiori Mikami}Hmph, all bark but no bite. Talked a big game but really, what a disappointment. Just now, who was just flapping their gums, saying they were gonna take Chiori down a peg or two?
Amongst the watching crowd's admiration for Chiori Mikami, the Jyanshi opposite stands up dejectedly from the table, a grudging and awkward smile on their face.
Jyanshi A
{character:Jyanshi A}Hey, we let you win. Otherwise you'd probably cry or something.
Jyanshi B & Jyanshi C
{character:Jyanshi B & Jyanshi C}Yeah! That's right!
Hearing this excuse, the other two Jyanshi nod frantically. Chiori Mikami's expression suddenly darkens.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Huh? Let me win? You three "glass fogeys"?
Jyanshi C
{character:Jyanshi C}Glass?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Your tactics and your tiles are like glass - I can see right through them.
Jyanshi B
{character:Jyanshi B}Er... Haha, can't you take a joke, kid? Don't need to take it so seriously, eh?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Back at you! After all, you looked a lot more serious when finding an excuse than playing!

Chiori Mikami unceremoniously calls them out, and the surrounding crowd gradually grows louder, showing that everyone else has issues with what the three Jyanshi had said, too. Their expressions grow more and more embarrassed, first blushing red and then turning pale as they pathetically hang their heads.
{character:Jyanshi A}Sorry, we were being petty. I apologize.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Instead of apologizing, get out of here and practice. I've lost count of the number of Jyanshi I've met who are all talk and no action.
Through a chorus of boos, the three red-faced Jyanshi leave in a hurry. Having watched the whole scene, I can't help but let out a sigh.
{character:player}So cocky... It wouldn't be surprising if she gets bundled into a sack one day while walking along the road.
While One Han City has always been peaceful, it's precisely because it is One Han City that you shouldn't get on the wrong side of a Jyanshi.
{character:Riu Kujou}Do you really think I'd let that happen?
{character:player}Riu? When did you get here?
The girl who silently appeared at my side is Riu Kujou, Chiori Mikami's maid. They're like sisters, despite one working for the other.

As Chiori's personal maid, Riu Kujou excels at forcibly defending her lady's honor, punishing anyone who disrespects or even has inappropriate thoughts about her. I've tasted the power of those iron fists myself on several occasions, when I've dared joke about Chiori Mikami.
...Hang on. I suddenly recall my kind of unthinking words just now, and feel some misgivings.
{character:player}Riu, what I said just now, about the sack... will you let me explain?
Riu Kujou
{character:Riu Kujou}What, do, YOU, think?
With a tight-lipped smile, Riu Kujou puts her powerful hands firmly on my shoulder.
{character:Riu Kujou}However, there's something more important to discuss with you right now.
"Boohoo... you just wait, someone's gonna come give you your just deserts..."

Seeing yet another Jyanshi run off in tears after being soundly thrashed by Chiori Mikami, I silently look back. Against the backdrop of her arrogant laughter, I look earnestly toward Riu Kujou's serious face.
{character:player}You see? Everyone says some inflammatory things in the heat of the moment. But you have to believe me, it was just words, and it's not like I really have a sack at hand!
{character:Riu Kujou}Shh-- hush now. What do you think a delicate girl like me could do to you?
{character:player}Are you redefining "delicate"...?
{character:Riu Kujou}Ah, there was a sudden gust of wind. What did you just say?
{character:player}Nothing.
{character:Riu Kujou}Uh-huh. Okay then. Let's get down to business, there's a matter that's giving me a bit of a headache that I want to discuss with you.
{character:player}Oh? Please, let me know if there's anything I can do to help.
Very rarely is the word "headache" ever heard from the mouth of the almost-omnipotent Riu Kujou, so it must be a really tricky problem.
{character:Riu Kujou}...A scoundrel. Especially dangerous.
{character:Riu Kujou}Why do you look so surprised? Wouldn't the existence of someone so dazzling as Miss Chiori be noticed by such a person?
{character:player}What I mean is, don't panic. You can take care of it.
{character:player}I see. But your tone tells me that things are a little different this time?
{character:Riu Kujou}Well, it was one night about a week ago. I called Miss Chiori to come down for dinner, but then something strange happened...
Riu Kujou describes the scene on that day for me.
{character:Riu Kujou}Dinner's ready, Miss... Miss Chiori?
Surprsingly, Chiori Mikami's bedroom is completely empty.

Riu Kujou's just about to go looking elsewhere, when *creak* a noise suddenly comes from the balcony. She looks over to see the sliding glass door open a crack, letting the sultry summer heat seep inside.
And the noise sounded like a creak from somebody on a swing.
{character:Riu Kujou}What are you doing on the balcony in this heat? Miss Chiori? Umm?

Thinking she's found her lady, Riu Kujou goes to the balcony, where she's left shocked and surprised. For there's no sign of Chiori Mikami, only the swing, moving by itself. The air is so dry and still, without even the slightest breeze. She steps forward and touches the seat of the swing, and finds it still warm.
Riu Kujou picks up a teddy bear that has fallen beside the swing, her expression serious.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Nice, big win! I knew I couldn't lose on my home ground! Riu...
Just then, Chiori Mikami's voice comes from outside the bedroom, revealing her actual location to be the small study next door.
Riu Kujou clears her head, hurriedly replaces the teddy bear onto the swing, and then runs out of the bedroom in response to Chiori's call.
{character:Riu Kujou}I'm here.
{character:Chiori Mikami}I just played a South Wind round, and am so hungry I think I could eat even more than Ichihime.
{character:Riu Kujou}Pff, I hear you. Tonight I've prepared beef pizza, and sour and spicy prawns, with a mango crepe cake for dessert. If that's not enough, I can also rustle up some pasta.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Wow! Are they the sour and spicy prawns we had at the restaurant last time? You learned how to make them, Riu?!
{character:Riu Kujou}I hope the taste will be as you remember, Miss.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Have some confidence! I'm sure what you make will be even better than the restaurant!
{character:Riu Kujou}With those words, Miss Chiori, I'll definitely make something more delicious.
{character:Riu Kujou}I'm very flattered that Miss Chiori ate all the shrimp I made that day.
{character:player}Whoa, they must have been amazing... Hang on, isn't the point of all this to tell me about this "scoundrel"?

{character:Riu Kujou}Oh, yeah! So anyway, that was the first time I learned of their existence. Afterward, there were several times when I was out with Miss Chiori and I felt like someone was spying on us from the shadows. A shame that they seemed pretty alert though, as they'd always disappeared before I could find them.
{character:player}Sounds stressful.

{character:Riu Kujou}Although I've already enrolled in the latest Special Maid Training class to sharpen my anti-surveillance skills, I don't think I can fully guarantee Miss Chiori's safety this time.
{character:player}You're already awesome, Riu. As far as I can tell, Chiori's always been well protected by you. But now that I know what's going on, what can I do to help?
{character:Riu Kujou}Join me to increase Miss Chiori's level of protection! If we share the work, we might even catch that scoundrel quicker!
{character:player}I'd be happy to, but why choose me, Riu?
{character:Riu Kujou}It wasn't so much me who chose you, but rather it was Miss Chiori's "consciousness" that chose you.
{character:player}Huh? What's that supposed to mean?

{character:Riu Kujou}Miss Chiori is not someone who easily trusts others. Despite seeming to dislike you whenever she sees you, she does always subconsciously seek your help when encountering any problems...
{character:Riu Kujou}Perhaps she doesn't even know herself when she formed this habit...
{character:Riu Kujou}So I reckon that she might be more likely to let you stay by her side.
{character:Riu Kujou}But worry not! It may have been my mistake that made Miss Chiori depend on an outsider, but I'll definitely make things right, and she'll be gone of you in no time!
That last sentence sent a shiver up my spine.
{character:player}Ahaha... Don't take things so seriously, for real.
{character:player}However... it doesn't matter if this scoundrel is a stalker, or has some other purpose. We'd better find them together as soon as possible.
{character:Riu Kujou}Shh-- keep your voice down! Miss Chiori herself still doesn't know about all this.
{character:player}Huh?

{character:Riu Kujou}If she found out, I just know she'd be so scared that she wouldn't eat or sleep. The most important thing is, from my understanding of her, that the lady would even think up a way to catch the scoundrel herself. And that's just too dangerous!
{character:Riu Kujou}So, you've gotta think up a reason to come with us.
{character:player}Eh... can't I just say I want to spend time with you two?
{character: Chiori Mikami}Spend time together? Why would I want to spend time with {var:player_nickname}?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Hmph. I don't. So forget it.
{character:player}... ...

Great. But at least it's not unexpected, and actually pretty normal considering it's Chiori Mikami. Riu Kujou stands by, trying to rescue our protection plan which is in danger of failing before it even starts.
{character:Riu Kujou}Didn't you say you wanted to arrange a time to see {var:player_nickname} when you had time, Miss Chiori?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Huh?! You're a fool, Riu! I've never, ever said that!
{character:Riu Kujou}Ah, I remember now. My mistake. How could you ever want to spend time with {var:player_nickname}, Miss Chiori.
I shoot a puzzled look at Riu Kujou, since we're meant to be on the same team and all now.
Well, I've gotta do all I can to keep Chiori Mikami safe.
{character:player}Why don't you want to hang out with me, Chiori?
{character:Chiori Mikami}I just don't feel like it. What's with all the "whys"?!
{character:Chiori Mikami}But you really want to see me so badly, {var:player_nickname}? That can't be because... you don't have any friends willing to spend time with you?
{character:player}Of course not! I came specially to look for you, Chiori. I even had to turn down other invitations!
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Hmph. Don't think you can fool me so easily. If it's not because you don't have other friends, then there has to be some other reason. Come clean!
Seems like I have to come up with a good enough reason to make her believe... Alright, let's just say...
After waving goodbye to Riu Kujou who kept looking back, I notice Chiori Mikami staring at me. The look in her eyes seems to scream "I see through everything."

I obediently cover my ears, and can only see Chiori Mikami say something with her back to me. Not long after, the bushes in front of me shake for a moment and several "fluffy balls" of different colors pop out.
As the saying goes, "no risk, no reward." I can't just obey because she's smart. Pretending to keep my ears covered, I wait until Chiori Mikami turns away for a second then quietly move my hands.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Meow-- meow-- meow--
The light of the setting sun glints on the hair of the girl beside me, shimmering with a gentle gold. She actually mimics a cat's meow, and her soft voice tickles my heart.
{character:Chiori Mikami}It's me! I've brought you some tasty snacks, so come on out, little ones.

This is the first time I've heard her speak in this sort of tone. If she'd been addressing me, her tone would have been totally different... My wandering thoughts are interrupted by the rustling bushes, which shake for a moment before several "fluffy balls" of different colors pop out.
The multicolored kittens meow, clearly familiar with Chiori Mikami, are hesitant to approach me, the two-legged stranger.

Chiori Mikami opens her bag and takes out some prepared cat food and snacks. As soon as one is open, these cautious - but not THAT cautious - little fluffy balls immediately swarm right up to our feet. Just then, a proffered bag of snacks is thrust into my line of sight, so I remove my hands from my ears and take it.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Let's feed them together. They won't be so scared of you then.
{character:player}Ahaha! Thanks, Chiori.
{character:Chiori Mikami}I-It's not for you! I can't just let them eat while scared.
{character:player}Mmhmm, I understand. So what you meant before was coming here to feed these strays? And Riu doesn't know about this?
{character:Chiori Mikami}I'm not a child! I don't need Riu to do absolutely everything for me!
{character:player}I know, I know. You do pretty well yourself.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Well, naturally.
Chiori Mikami turns her head and intently feeds the kitten, only the tip of her red ears revealing her true feelings. She seems happy to have brought a friend to her secret base.

However, if Chiori Mikami wasn't originally playing in the children's playground, how did she discover these kittens in such a remote place? I decide to keep this question to myself, in order to maintain the peaceful atmosphere.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Eh?!
{character:player}Wh-What?
Chiori Mikami's exclamation startles me, and I think she's read my mind again.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...This isn't right. There's one missing.
{character:Chiori Mikami}There were five last time I came. But I haven't seen the little orange one since I got here.
{character:player}Your mahjong skills have improved yet again! But I'd expect nothing less from Chiori Mikami, girl genius.
As soon as I say this, Chiori Mikami immediately looks at me as she gets off the mahjong table. She walks toward me with an expression of "I know it's you."
{character:Chiori Mikami}You don't need to tell me that. But I'm afraid time's running out today, and you'll just have to wait until next time for me to bully you. Let's go, Riu.
{character:Riu Kujou}Yes, Miss Chiori.
{character:player}...Riu? When did you sneak up on me?
Glad I didn't say anything stupid just now. Dodged a bullet.
I watch Chiori Mikami and Riu Kujou leave the shrine, then turn to see Ichihime staring at me, lost in thought.
Ichihime
{character:Ichihime}...A little strange, nyaa.
{character:player}What's strange?
{character:Ichihime}Just now, Riu quietly approached you like she had something to say, but didn't say it, nyaa.
{character:player}Riu?
{character:Ichihime}It had to be to ask what tasty food you brought! It smells so good, nyaa!

{character:player}...I think that might be what you wanted to ask... Hey hey hey, I'll give it to you later at a restaurant, don't just waltz over here in broad daylight and start sniffing... let alone digging right in!!!

...Raising a cat really is a matter of patience! After feeding Ichihime, we play a few rounds of mahjong before the sky darkens and I leave the shrine. In the cool evening air, I keep replaying the day's matches in my mind, and then without even realizing it, I find myself near Chiori Mikami's house.
Speaking of which, compared to Ichihime's unorthodox, intuitive style of play, it's a pity that I couldn't see Chiori Mikami's matches just now. She'd probably be more tactical.
Bzzz-- The phone rings. Is it actually Riu Kujou?
{character:player}Hey, Riu?
{character:Riu Kujou}Have you seen Miss Chiori, {var:player_nickname}?
{character:player}Didn't she leave with you?
{character:Riu Kujou}Yes. We went home after leaving the shrine. I was just preparing a meal when she said she was going to the nearby park for a while, but she still hasn't come back.
{character:Riu Kujou}Isn't she with you right now?
{character:player}I'm afraid not. However, if it's that little park close to her house... I happen to be in the neighborhood.
{character:Riu Kujou}Eh? Really? Great! In that case, could I trouble you to look for her? I'm on my way out the door too!
{character:player}Not a problem at all, but... calm down, let me get this straight. When did she say she was heading out?
{character:Riu Kujou}At 17:31. She said she'd only be gone for half an hour.
{character:player}Is being so frighteningly precise a quality of being a professional maid?... Hang on, it says here that it's exactly 18:00, which technically means it hasn't yet been half an hour.

{character:Riu Kujou}She's not in my field of vision, which means there's no way Miss Chiori could get home in the next one minute. And she didn't take her phone with her either. This all makes me worried.

{character:player}Very rigorous deduction. However, there are loads of reasons why you may not have heard from her for half an hour. One Han City's a pretty safe place, and this sort of thing isn't like having an accident or going missing, so why don't we wait and see?
{character:Riu Kujou}Impossible! What if she did have an accident?!
{character:player}...Riu, do you think you might be a little overreacting?
{character:Riu Kujou}...
{character:Chiori Mikami}...
Riu Kujou pauses for a moment. I hear her take a deep breath, and her suddenly raised voice returns to its usual calm.
{character:player}What?
Then, Riu Kujou tells me something I didn't know before on the phone.
{character:Riu Kujou}To be specific, a week ago I had finished preparing dinner and gone to call Miss Chiori down, when something strange happened...
Just then, Chiori Mikami's voice comes from outside the bedroom, indicating that her actual location is the small study next door.
Riu Kujou clears her head, hurriedly replaces the teddy bear onto the swing, then runs out of the bedroom in response to Chiori Mikami's call.
{character:Riu Kujou}That was the first time I learned of their existence. Afterward, whenever I was out with Miss Chiori I felt several times like someone was spying on us from the shadows.
{character:player}Does Chiori know about this?

{character:Riu Kujou}No, she doesn't. I don't want her to get scared over potentially nothing. Oh, I'm just not good enough, so I've already enrolled in the latest Special Maid Training class to sharpen my anti-surveillance skills!
{character:player}You've already done really well, Riu, and I think I have a grasp of the situation. She said she was going to the park, right? Then that's where I'll start looking for her.
{character:Riu Kujou}Thank you so much!

Given that it's dinner time, there aren't many people in the park. I search the square dancing team, the public mahjong tables, and the children's playground, but find no glimpse of Chiori Mikami anywhere. I have to expand my search to include areas near the park.
Since she was only going for half an hour, and didn't take her phone, Chiori Mikami couldn't have gone far. The fact that she's nowhere to be found is a little worrying, but... something's not right.
I look around and find the source of the weirdness - I'm clearly the only one nearby, but I feel like I'm being watched.
I'm suddenly reminded of the strange event Riu Kujou had told me about... What if it's that mysterious scoundrel? But whoever that is wouldn't have a reason to follow me, surely?
I calm the goosebumps across my body, then suddenly rush to where I feel the strange feeling of being watched is coming from.
{character:player}Who's there?! Come out!
A figure flashes by in a split second, running to a different area. While I didn't get a good look... there's something familiar about that red hairband poking out from the bushes over there.
{character:player}...Chiori? Is that you?
Whoever it is goes quiet for a couple of seconds, then suddenly reaches out and pulls the hairband down.
That's not very subtle!!!
I advance a few steps toward where they're hiding, only to hear the bushes rustle and see the person who seems to be Chiori Mikami run farther away.
{character:player}...Is Chiori playing some weird version of hide and seek? Why not come out? Riu asked me to find you!
{character:???}... ...
{character:???}Meow.
The other person doesn't reply directly, but from a distance responds with a surprisingly realistic meow.
Why would Chiori Mikami rather use the hackneyed method of imitating a cat to hide herself, instead of just coming out? This is just too strange.
The situation is so weird that I can't act rashly. I need to figure out a way to get her to come out first.
I decide to use some mind games to trap this odd stalker, so I yell--
{character:player}Chiori Mikami's skill at mahjong is just average!
{character:Chiori Mikami}You peasant! Let's have a match right now if you think you're up for it!
The girl who suddenly springs up from behind the bushes has her hands on her hips, a completely unbelieving expression on her face. Good, it's her.
{character:player}Haha, finally willing to come out, eh?
My tone is too proud, and Chiori Mikami's eyes flash with pure fury.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Argh! You despicable, cunning, shameless, creep!!!
{character:player}You're the one who followed me, hid when discovered, then pretended to be a cat when found out, no?

{character:Chiori Mikami}...Nonsense. Clearly it's you, a strange commoner, who suddenly appeared in the place I was passing through, harboring unknown intentions! Your sneaky maliciousness seemed like you wanted to shove me in a sack, so of course I wasn't going to come out!
{character:player}You're just making things up!
{character:Chiori Mikami}You've got sinister motives!
{character:player}Come clean!
{character:Chiori Mikami}My business is none of yours!
{character:player}See?! You still say you're not hiding anything from me! Let something slip?
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Just wait until I go back and tell Riu about what you've said and your total arrogance.
{character:player}I apologize, my lady.

I raise my hand in surrender to declare a "truce". The wise adapt to the situation, and while mind games are useful, it's also wise to know when to stop. There's no point in doing things that will only hurt yourself.
And anyway, now that Chiori Mikami's been found, it's better to let Riu Kujou know so she doesn't worry.
I send a message to Riu Kujou.
{character:Riu Kujou}(Text message) Found her? That's great! Where are you?
{character:player}Alright... We're...
I stop as I'm just about to type and look around. There are no evident landmarks nearby. Recalling that Chiori Mikami lives in the area, I look at her.
{character:player}Chiori? Chiori? Chioriiii?!
{character:Chiori Mikami}I'm not talking to you if you're just gonna repeat yourself!
{character:player}Uh, I mean, what is this place? Riu wants to confirm where you are.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...This place... this... is a street near my house.
{character:player}Huh? That description won't be of much help. Could you be a bit more specific?
{character:Chiori Mikami}...A pretty narrow street near my house!
{character:player}Come on, don't be like that. That's not what I meant by specific. Can't you tell me something like what direction it is from your house, or the street's name... Wait...
I catch her flash of embarrassment, and it suddenly hits me.
{character:player}So... Chiori, were you secretly following me because you're lost?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Vicious slander! I, Chiori Mikami, could never get lost!!!!
Despite Chiori Mikami's ear-splitting denial, her sudden blushing betrays her.
Unwilling to admit to being lost so close to home, preferring to "follow the familiar face" than ask for help... Since these are the facts, all I can say is--
{character:player}Well, that's classic Chiori.
Well, that's classic Chiori.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...{var:player_nickname}...
{character:player}Now, now, don't do anything rash... All I meant was that your ability to think on your feet and get out of trouble is amazing!
{character:Chiori Mikami}...Hmph. Don't think I don't know when I'm being insulted. But Chiori doesn't waste time on idiots. Hand it over!
{character:player}Good thing I'm so smart.
{character:Chiori Mikami}You? Smart? That's a joke. Now give it to me!
Chiori Mikami stalks toward me, seething. I'm ready to defend myself against a vicious attack, but she suddenly reaches out and grabs my phone. She snaps several photos and sends them to Riu Kujou.
{character:Chiori Mikami}Morons will be morons. Isn't this a more effective way of letting her know where we are?
{character:player}...Fine.

Chiori Mikami tosses my phone back to me in a huff. Now that I'm closer to her, I suddenly realize something about her is different from normal - her hair is a little messy, and there's visible dust on her normally-pristine skirt and sleeves. There's no way her hiding place would have made her that dusty.
{character:Chiori Mikami}What are you looking at?! Turn around!

Sensing my gaze, Chiori Mikami puts her hands behind her back in frustration. Apparently, being not beautiful enough is one of the reasons why she's unwilling to come out and meet me. But what actually happened to her? Could it be connected with that "scoundrel"?
{character:player}Can you tell me where you just were, Chiori? How come you were lost?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Shut it! There's no way I'm gonna tell you. You'd just laugh at me!

{character:player}I'm not asking so I can make fun of you, Chiori, but because I'm worried. Your safety is my priority, so I'll force you out of hiding and make sure you're really okay, even if it makes you angry.
{character:Chiori Mikami}...You've got a really smart mouth on you.
Perhaps it's my serious tone, but Chiori Mikami only pouts as the rage in her eyes gradually subsides.
{character:player}Please, won't you tell me?

{character:Chiori Mikami}...Hmph, look at your pitiful face. I suppose that if I don't tell you, you'll probably not be able to stay focused and keep losing at mahjong. And if you, a fragile commoner, become so desperate over losing that you give up on life, it will only cause me more trouble.
{character:player}You're completely right. So, you'll tell me?
{character:Chiori Mikami}...I went to rescue a kitten.
{character:player}A kitten?

{character:Chiori Mikami}There's a calico stray cat in the park. She's pretty vicious and won't let me pet her, but she did give birth to a litter of kittens. They're totally exposed to the elements, so I come to feed them when I can. I was about to head back after feeding them today as usual, when I noticed that one of the kittens was missing. The mother led me to where her kitten was trapped, and I went to rescue it.
{character:Chiori Mikami}And that's it. That's all that happened.
{character:player}Huh?
{character:Chiori Mikami}You'd better not say you didn't hear, and want me to repeat myself.
{character:player}No, no, I heard!
{character:player}Ahaha! So that's what happened. Look at you and your kind heart, Chiori. Does Riu know about this?
{character:Chiori Mikami}I'm not a child! I don't need Riu to do absolutely everything for me!

So that's how it is. From how much Riu Kujou looks after Chiori Mikami, if she knew about this trivial matter she'd probably immediately add "take care of lady's park kitties" to her daily list of tasks.
{character:player}Okay, I understand. You do pretty well yourself. So, where's this kitten you saved?
{character:Chiori Mikami}Its mother carried it off as soon as it was rescued.
{character:player}Wow... so thankless.
{character:Chiori Mikami}That's just how cats are. They won't be picked on if they're vigilant. After all, not everyone is as kind and lovely as me!
{character:player}Hmm, I suppose you're right. Well, at least Riu and I can rest easy now...
Having heard this much, and not just about Chiori Mikami getting lost, I have my own suspicions about Riu Kujou's "scoundrel". I'll have a chat with her when I head back later.
{character:Chiori Mikami}I've already told you what you wanted to know, so stop making me stand here! Show me the way out! Index and I want to have a bath!
